name: controlled_phase
description: CP in every role on three qubits: control and target swapped, a negative angle and an integral angle (Python prints 1.0), on an H-prepared state so the phase is not invisible.

code.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.cp(1.5707963267948966, 0, 1)
qc.cp(-0.25, 2, 0)
qc.cp(1.0, 1, 2)
code.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(3)
# Cirq lists q[0] first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.H(q[0]),
    cirq.H(q[1]),
    cirq.H(q[2]),
    cirq.cphase(1.5707963267948966)(q[0], q[1]),
    cirq.cphase(-0.25)(q[2], q[0]),
    cirq.cphase(1.0)(q[1], q[2]),
)
code.pennylane:
import pennylane as qml

dev = qml.device("default.qubit", wires=3)


@qml.qnode(dev)
def circuit():
    qml.Hadamard(wires=0)
    qml.Hadamard(wires=1)
    qml.Hadamard(wires=2)
    qml.ControlledPhaseShift(1.5707963267948966, wires=[0, 1])
    qml.ControlledPhaseShift(-0.25, wires=[2, 0])
    qml.ControlledPhaseShift(1.0, wires=[1, 2])
    # PennyLane lists wire 0 first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
    return qml.state()
